01 — WHO WE ARE

Building Trust Across Construction, Trade & Marine

A Qatar-based company focused on dependable construction, marine maintenance and trading solutions for major infrastructure and industrial projects.

Mission Statement

Our mission is to forge long-term relationships with our customers by delivering high-quality products, marine, and construction services. We are committed to meeting specifications and maintaining professionalism, while offering competitive pricing worldwide.

Company Vision

We aspire to be inspirational and forward-thinking leaders in global service and trading, growing our business presence while upholding trust and responsibility through professional engineering, marine and construction services.

02 — WHAT WE DO

Three Sectors, One Standard of Excellence

01

Construction & Contracting

General contracting, civil and structural works, foundation and formwork, rebar and concreting, electrical contracts, and site preparation for major infrastructure and real-estate projects.

02

Marine Services

Maintenance of main engines and diesel generators for LNG carriers, heavy machinery installation, rail fixing and marine transportation equipment upkeep for leading offshore operators.

03

Trading & Supply

Supply of ready-mix concrete, engineering aggregates, building materials, heavy equipment and spare parts — sourced and delivered to specification across Qatar.

Construction & Contracting in Qatar

JADK Trading & Contracting supports construction and infrastructure projects in Qatar, including civil works, foundations, concrete works, rebar works, site preparation, fencing and heavy machinery installation.

Industrial and Marine Services

Our project experience includes industrial installation, ship engine maintenance support and related workshop works.

Construction Materials and Supply

We support projects through construction material, aggregate and industrial equipment supply.
